4.2.claim: PADOVA secondary motor outcomes were also non-significant: time-to-worsening of motor function HR 0.82 (95% CI 0.66 to 1.03, p=0.0914); change in bradykinesia and rigidity difference 0.08 (95% CI -1.08 to 1.24, p=0.8955); change in motor function MDS-UPDRS Part III difference -0.39 (95% CI -1.84 to 1.05, p=0.5944).

4.3.claim: PASADENA exploratory analyses suggested greater motor effects in faster progressors; PADOVA had supportive trends and a nominal signal in a prespecified levodopa subgroup.

4.4.claim: Roche announced advancement to phase III in June 2025 using the total evidence; this is development continuation/redesign, not a demonstrated clinical rescue.
